root_cause: Delivery latency was dominated by orchestration fan-out and superseded work. Remaining hotspots included candidate-shadow/canary flights, JS/TS CodeQL initialization on non-JS/TS PRs, Supabase applicability checkout on non-Supabase PRs, and Netlify builds for changes already classified as non-deployment.
prevention_rule: Keep required check contexts visible while moving applicability decisions ahead of expensive work; cancel stale logical flights by PR/ref; skip Netlify only for a fail-open allowlist of proven non-Netlify paths.
evidence: Latest sampled 100 Actions runs: 45 queued, 7 in progress, 18 cancelled, 10 successful.
Inspected Netlify production deploy reported 122 seconds deploy_time and about 6m41 created-to-published.
Current main already contains PR-scoped cancellation for writer gate dispatch and operational verification.
